note: Model time is the provider-measured latency of the calls on a question's path: retrieval (facet planning, then admission), the slowest of its parallel per-session extraction calls, and the answer. It excludes building the session notes, which LongMemEval-S needs once per question history.

cost.basis: Generation prices are the run configuration. Judge estimate assumes GPT-4o input $2.50/M and output $10/M. Computed from logged tokens; provider bills may differ.

latency_split.note: Pre-processing writes one note per session before any question; a history is ready when its slowest note is done (notes run in parallel). Query time is retrieval (facet planning, admission, per-session extraction) plus the answer. Cold start is a new history and then its first question.

history_tokens_note: LongMemEval-S gives each question a history of about 115,000 tokens (about 50 sessions).
